meta.name: get-qodo-rules
meta.description: Loads org- and repo-level coding rules from Qodo before code tasks begin, ensuring all generation and modification follows team standards. Use before any code generation or modification task when rules are not already loaded. Invoke when user asks to write, edit, refactor, or review code, or when starting implementation planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 加载团队编码规则，确保代码符合规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队有编码规则需要自动遵守
copy.tagline_en: Load team coding rules to ensure code compliance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team has coding rules to enforce automatically

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 在开始写、改、审查等代码任务前,会先从 Qodo 拉取团队编码规则并按严重程度分级处理,结束后汇报哪些规则被应用。
howto.when: 当用户要求写、改或重构代码等,或开始实施计划时;也可用“get rules”等指令手动触发。

say.text: 先加载 Qodo 规则,再开始写代码。
say.note: Claude 会先从 Qodo 拉取规则并展示。

say.text: 从 Qodo 获取项目规范,再重构这个函数。
say.note: 加载规则后按规则重构。

say.text: 加载团队代码规则,再审查这个 PR。
say.note: 规则加载后会用于审查。

howto.what_en: After installation, before starting code tasks like writing, editing, or reviewing, Claude first fetches team coding rules from Qodo and processes them by severity; afterwards it reports which rules were applied.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to write, edit, or refactor code, or starts implementation planning; can also be invoked manually with commands like 'get rules'.

say_en.text: Load Qodo rules first, then start writing code.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch and show the rules.

say_en.text: Fetch project rules from Qodo, then refactor this function.
say_en.note: Rules loaded and applied to refactor.

say_en.text: Load team code rules, then review this PR.
say_en.note: Rules are used for the review.
